tasks.check: deno check main.ts src/application/**/*.ts src/contracts/**/*.ts src/host/**/*.ts src/renderer/**/*.ts src/build/**/*.ts src/workbench/{cli,compile-permissions,contracts,host,proxy,runtime,workspace}.ts && deno check --config=../deno.json src/sidecar/main.ts src/workbench/main.ts
tasks.fmt: deno fmt --check deno.json README.md component-manifest.json main.ts src
tasks.workbench:compile: deno task ui:build && deno run --no-prompt --allow-run=deno --allow-write=dist --deny-env --deny-net src/build/compile-workbench-helper.ts
tasks.workbench:test: deno task workbench:compile && deno test --allow-read --allow-write --allow-net=127.0.0.1:5176 --allow-run=dist/helpers/casys-workbench src/workbench src/build/compiled-workbench-helper_e2e_test.ts
tasks.sidecar:compile: deno task ui:build && deno run --no-prompt --allow-run=deno --allow-write=dist --deny-env --deny-net src/build/compile-control-plane-helper.ts && deno run --no-prompt --allow-run=deno --allow-write=dist --deny-env --deny-net src/build/compile-workbench-helper.ts
tasks.sidecar:test: deno task sidecar:compile && deno test --allow-read --allow-write --allow-net=127.0.0.1:3020,127.0.0.1:5176 --allow-run=deno,dist/helpers/casys-control-plane,dist/helpers/casys-workbench src/sidecar src/workbench src/build
tasks.verify: deno task fmt && deno task lint && deno task check && deno task test && deno task runtime:check
tasks.package: deno task runtime:check && deno task sidecar:compile && DENO_BIN=$(which deno) && PATH="$PWD/dist/helpers:$PATH" "$DENO_BIN" desktop --no-prompt --deny-import -P=desktop --output=dist/CasysDigitalThread.app main.ts && deno run --no-prompt --allow-read=dist --allow-write=dist --allow-run=/usr/bin/plutil,/usr/bin/codesign,/usr/bin/clang src/build/finalize-macos.ts dist/CasysDigitalThread.app
